baseline_models.focus_anchor: The grammatical subject يَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ binds remaining to the Lord's face, while the ذو construction qualifies that whole subject.
baseline_models.mechanism: Persistence and face-as-self prevent وَجْه from becoming a surviving fragment: the Lord's own presence persists, and lordship plus praiseworthy generosity describe that presence as sovereign and giving.

activation_trace.role: Persistence rather than perishing supplies the temporal force of the predicate.
Face used for self or essence makes the persisting subject the Lord's own presence, not an isolated bodily part.
Lordship, ownership, and authority give the enduring presence sovereign rather than merely durable force.
Praiseworthy nobility and generosity make that sovereignty munificent rather than bare dominance.

changed_reading.before: A face belonging to the Lord remains.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's own sovereign and giving presence is the non-lapsing subject.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ can be read through the focus inventory's direction and proper-course branches while remaining grammatically governed by يَبْقَىٰ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can name not only an enduring self but an enduring orientation: the Lord's direction and sound course remain available as the path along which nurture reaches completion.

activation_trace.role: Continuance gives the orientation temporal stability.
Direction, destination, and path supply the literal orientation that remains.
The proper aspect or well-managed course turns direction into a norm for action, not mere spatial bearing.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the enduring course developmental and purposive.
Willing welcome and honor give the Lordward course a receptive relational tone.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports what entity survives.
changed_reading.after: It can also preserve the Lordward direction and proper course that do not lapse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same sequence joins a remaining verb, a face-to-face noun, lordly nurture, and willing honor.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant branch of ب ق ي carries sparing and preserved affection after fault. Combined with confrontation and willing honor, it weakly activates a relational claim: the possibility of audience is not withdrawn even when creatures fail.

activation_trace.role: Sparing and preserving affection supplies the exploratory sense of an encounter deliberately kept open.
Face-to-face meeting turns abstract persistence into continuing encounter.
Nurture and repair make the encounter restorative rather than merely observational.
A formula of willing honor supplies gracious reception as the encounter's affective mode.

changed_reading.before: Divine presence simply outlasts finite beings.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the Lord does not withdraw the gracious possibility of being faced and received.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disclosure, calculation, balance, and justice enact the focus branch of وَجْه as a proper course. The enduring face therefore becomes the stable orientation by which cosmic regularity and human dealing can share one measure.

activation_trace.role: The proper aspect or sound course provides the focus anchor for a normative order.
Nurture toward completion lets that order form and correct what it governs.
Disclosure to a knower supplies intelligibility as the first operation of the enduring course.
Counting and calculation give the course determinate regularity.
The balance of justice transfers measured regularity from the cosmos into obligation.
Equity supplies the ethical realization of the same ordered course.

structural_cues: Teaching and disclosure open the sequence; calculated luminaries lead into the raised sky, the placed balance, and commands against transgression and loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, calculation, balance, and equity; I infer that these are enacted instances of وَجْه as the Lord's proper course. A live alternative is that they are products of sovereignty without defining the face.

changed_reading.before: The enduring orientation is an abstract Lordward direction.
changed_reading.after: It is also the durable measured course that coordinates intelligibility, cosmos, and just human action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opposed risings and settings, then two expanses that meet while a relation between them holds, spatialize the enduring face. Lordward orientation is not one localized front; it remains across opposed horizons and at a meeting that preserves difference.

activation_trace.role: Direction and destination anchor the reading in the focus word.
Facing and opposition allow orientation to remain relational across two sides.
Light rising from the east supplies one horizon of directed appearance.
Sunset and west supply the opposed horizon without canceling direction.
Two things arriving opposite one another turn horizon polarity into an encounter.
A relation connecting endpoints explains how meeting and distinction can coexist.

structural_cues: The dual easts and wests are followed by dual waters that meet yet do not overrun one another.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed horizons, encounter, and an interstitial relation; I infer that these distribute وَجْه across polarity rather than locating it at one point. The alternative is a catalogue of separate cosmological signs.

changed_reading.before: The Lordward face suggests a single fixed direction.
changed_reading.after: The enduring face can orient every opposed horizon and remain present in a meeting that does not erase difference.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding totality and cessation sharpen ب ق ي by contrast. Its residue branch is activated and then overturned: the face is not a leftover quantity within the same inventory as perishing beings, but the self that is not exhausted by that inventory at all.

activation_trace.role: The remaining-portion image raises the tempting but inadequate model of a residue after loss.
Face-as-self moves the surviving subject out of part-whole arithmetic.
All as encompassing totality makes the field of finite loss exhaustive.
Cessation and departure after prior existence supply the fate from which the focus subject is categorically distinguished.

structural_cues: 55:26 and 55:27 form an adjacent كل...فان / ويبقى... contrast with a change of subject rather than a remainder named from the first set.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive totality, cessation, persistence, and face-as-self; I infer a categorical asymmetry rather than subtraction leaving one item. A live alternative is the simpler temporal sequence 'all ends, then this remains.'

changed_reading.before: The Lord's face is the final remainder among the ruins of everything else.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's self is not a residue of the world's inventory; remaining names a different order of non-exhaustion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Universal asking, recurrent time, and an affair capable of being set right convert persistence from immobility into inexhaustible responsiveness. The remaining Lordly face is continuously available because nurture is continuously under way.

activation_trace.role: Persistence supplies continuity without requiring inactivity.
Repair, nurture, and completion provide the governing work performed through time.
Asking and requesting supply the creatures' continuing dependence and address.
A duration of time makes the activity recurrent rather than a single response.
Setting work right and doing it well supplies constructive content to each affair.

structural_cues: After the remain/perish contrast, everyone in the heavens and earth asks, and the singular subject is in an affair every day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal request, repeated duration, and competent action; I infer a response relation between requests and affairs. The alternative is juxtaposition of dependence and divine activity without a causal arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: Remaining means static survival after creation ends.
changed_reading.after: Remaining is dynamically inexhaustible governance: the face endures by never ceasing to receive dependence and bring affairs toward completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attempted passage beyond the cosmic sides requires sovereign authorization; later, recognition by visible marks ends in seizure. These movements darken the preserved-encounter baseline: the remaining face is not only gracious availability but jurisdiction that flight turns into unavoidable confrontation.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face confrontation anchors the judicial encounter in the focus noun.
Lordship and authority make the confrontation jurisdictional.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the attempted escape across a boundary.
Power and delegated authority make passage conditional on sovereignty rather than distance alone.
Recognition by trace or sign makes identity immediately legible at encounter.
A visible mark disclosing condition supplies the evidence by which recognition occurs.
Capture and detention turn recognition into enforceable encounter.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from a challenge to penetrate the heavens and earth, through denied escape and cosmic rupture, to identification without interrogation and bodily seizure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed passage, required authority, visible recognition, and capture; I connect spatial non-escape to face-to-face jurisdiction. The alternative is that the escape scene and recognition scene are discrete warnings.

changed_reading.before: The remaining face is a gracious audience that stays open.
changed_reading.after: The same enduring presence is also an inescapable accountable encounter: no outer boundary evades its recognition or authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hidden garden, flowing source, reachable harvest, and reciprocal good render إكرام as a sustaining gift ecology. Honor is not merely rank attached to the enduring face; it is provision that grows, approaches the recipient, and answers good with good.

activation_trace.role: Good growth and rain-bearing bounty supply the generative material of honor.
A gift offered in relation to recompense supplies the exchange structure later made explicit.
A garden concealed by its trees supplies the hospitable domain in which bounty matures.
A flowing spring supplies continuing nourishment rather than a one-time gift.
Taking ripe produce from its source turns growth into receivable provision.
Nearness makes the provision approach its recipient rather than remain remote display.
Answering an act with its recompense realizes the relational side of the focus gift branch.
Good action repeated on both sides gives the exchange its ethical quality.

structural_cues: The garden sequence repeatedly moves from contained abundance to flowing water, paired fruit, near harvest, and the question that makes good action answerable by good action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth, concealment, flow, harvest, nearness, and recompense; I infer one hospitality mechanism that materially unfolds إكرام. The alternative is a list of independent rewards joined only by setting.

changed_reading.before: إكرام is an abstract honor possessed by the enduring Lordly face.
changed_reading.after: إكرام is enacted as inexhaustible hospitality: cultivated provision comes near and good is answered with good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing reprise substitutes the Lord's name for the Lord's face while repeating lordship and honor. Stable, growing good plus the name as an identifying indication recast the remaining face as enduring self-disclosure whose beneficence does not merely survive but proliferates.

activation_trace.role: Persistence supplies the opening side of the face/name frame.
Face-as-self makes the first frame a mode of personal presence.
Stable good that grows changes bare endurance into enduring fecundity.
The name as proclamation and indication supplies another mode by which the same Lord is present and known.
Staying, clinging, and lasting echo the focus predicate inside the repeated Lord-title.
Repeated praiseworthy generosity closes the frame with the same relational quality as the focus.

structural_cues: 55:27 and 55:78 repeat the Lord-title and the coordinated الجلال/الإكرام construction while changing face-remains to name-is-blessed; ج ل ل has no branch inventory and is used only for this structural repetition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the frame repetition, face-as-self, name-as-indication, lasting lordship, and growing good; I infer that face and name parallel modes of self-disclosure. The alternative is that they are two independent praise formulas linked only by repeated wording.

changed_reading.before: A visible face survives and is honored.
changed_reading.after: The enduring self is disclosed through face and name, and its stable good remains actively generative rather than merely left over.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the obstetric presentation branch of وَجْه and the birth branch of وضع across nominal and contextual distance. It remains anchored in the focus face, the non-dominant growth mapping of ر ب ب, and packet branches for womb, origination, and birth. Downstream prose should call it a material analogy for emergence, never a lexical gloss or a claim of literal divine parturition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun وَجْه carries a hands-first presentation branch, while the split ر ب ب inventory preserves a non-dominant nurture-and-growth branch.

activation_trace.role: Hands-first birth presentation supplies a literal frontward emergence image for the focus face.
Nurture and growing up from the non-dominant mapped root supply maturation after emergence.
Good growth and rain-bearing bounty make the emergence fruitful rather than merely mechanical.
The womb image supplies enclosed generation at the opening edge of the context.
Origination and bringing creation into being supply the emergence of finite forms.
Putting down a burden in birth supplies the transition from enclosure into the placed creaturely world.

changed_reading.before: The face is a static object that remains after created forms perish.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the enduring face is a birthward orientation from which finite forms can emerge, mature, and pass without exhausting their source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a lid on a vessel is a remote material branch of ك ر م. It remains valid as an activation, not a gloss, because it is anchored in focus branches for cover, outward face, and held reserve, then reinforced by packet images of a plant sheath, a tree-hidden garden, and an inner lining. Downstream prose should qualify it as protective-containment imagery rather than equating إكرام with covering.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus inventory lets إكرام activate a covering plate while وَجْه supplies the outward front and يَبْقَىٰ supplies a reserve held back.

activation_trace.role: A plate covering the top of a vessel supplies the protective cap at the focus.
The face or outward front supplies the visible surface over an interior.
Holding part back in reserve supplies what the covering preserves rather than displays.
A plant vessel or fruit sheath supplies protective containment during growth.
A garden hidden by trees expands the container image into a sheltered domain of bounty.
An inner lining distinguishes concealed richness from the outward face that covers it.

changed_reading.before: Honor is visible rank or largesse displayed by the enduring face.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, honor also protects a held reserve and shelters interior bounty until it can be received.

strongest_changes: The 55:26 contrast converts remaining from a last residue into categorical non-exhaustion.
55:29 converts permanence from static survival into recurrent, responsive governance.
The judgment sequence makes the same enduring face an unavoidable encounter as well as a gracious one.
The gardens materialize إكرام as sustaining hospitality, and 55:78 reframes face through name and stable, growing good.
summary.what_was_special: A static survival reading repeatedly became relational without collapsing into one result: measured orientation, cross-horizon presence, active nurture, accountable confrontation, cultivated hospitality, and name-borne self-disclosure remain coexisting readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The directional and proper-course senses of وَجْه may be live mechanisms or lexical potentials that context does not force.
The response arrow between universal asking and each-day affairs is abductive; the clauses may instead juxtapose dependence and activity.
The sparing sense of ب ق ي and both material outliers are form-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.
ج ل ل lacks a branch inventory, so its recurrence can support only the structural 55:27/55:78 frame, not a branch-level claim.
